title: Score to letter grade
hints: Check the highest grade first. Once one check matches, `return` right away.
Use a chain: `if (score >= 90) ... else if (score >= 80) ... else if ...` and a final `else` for "F".
if (score >= 90) return "A"; if (score >= 80) return "B"; if (score >= 70) return "C"; if (score >= 60) return "D"; return "F";
